in_sanskrit.name: प्रीतिका
in_sanskrit.meaning: दर्दानहिता (प्रीति) का (का) नाम ज्योतिषादिमें शुद्ध संस्कृतमें प्रसिद्ध है। प्रीति का अर्थ प्रेम है, जिसका अनुसार प्रीतिका प्रेमी या प्रेमित है।
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Preetika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'preeti', which means 'love, affection, or dear'. The suffix 'ka' indicates the feminine gender. In Hindu astrology, the name is commonly used for the planet Venus. The name is pure in Sanskrit and holds great significance in various aspects of Indian culture.

in_hindi.name: प्रीतिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: Preetika is a name of Hindi origin, which means 'lovable, dear, or dear one'. The name is derived from the word 'preeti', which signifies love, affection, or dear.

in_tamil.name: பிரித்திகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Preetika may have slightly different meanings, but it generally conveys the sense of being lovable, dear, or cherished. One possible interpretation of the name is 'one who is cherished or longed for like a precious gem'. The Tamil language is one of the major Dravidian languages spoken in India.

in_telugu.name: ప్రీతిక
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Preetika may have slight variations in pronunciation and meaning compared to other Indian languages. One possible interpretation of the name is 'one who is dear to Lord Shiva, Lord Vishnu, and Lord Shodash'. The Telugu language is another major Dravidian language spoken in India.

in_marathi.long_meaning: Preetika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from Sanskrit ‘preeti’ meaning love and ‘ka’ meaning beautiful. A name for a beautiful, loved one.
